title: Room Reservations Further Advance Deposit on Resort Reservations
content:
## Rule

When a change raises the nightly rate of a confirmed resort reservation guaranteed by an advance deposit, the deposit the reservation requires is worked out again and the part of it the money held does not cover is collected from the guest's card as a further deposit; money already held is never refunded by this rule. A further deposit is collected only on a reservation whose status is confirmed, and it is the guest who pays it with the card on file. The rule governs Room Reservations reservations at resort-brand hotels whose guarantee is an advance deposit.

No further advance deposit is collected until the extra-person charge for every adult beyond those the nightly rate covers has been added to the reservation's nightly rate.

An additional deposit is collected only after each late cancellation penalty kept from money held on another reservation of the same guest at the same hotel for overlapping nights, where it exceeds the penalty that cancellation owes, carries a penalty reversal entry naming it.

| Before a further deposit is collected | Shown by |
|---|---|
| The reservation's status is confirmed | the reservation record |
| It is guaranteed by an advance deposit | the guarantee on the reservation record |
| Every late cancellation penalty kept from money held on another reservation of the same guest at the same hotel for overlapping nights, where it exceeds what that cancellation owes, carries a penalty reversal entry naming it | the charge records of those reservations |

## Paying the further deposit: `pay_deposit_topup_8cd35ccc`

**Capability.** With this tool the guest pays a further advance deposit on their own room reservation with the card stored on their profile. One new deposit collection is recorded on the reservation for the amount given, dated today, and the money is added to what the hotel holds for that reservation; the guest sees the payment on the reservation's deposit history straight away.

**Invocation.** It is the customer's own tool: guest services unlocks `pay_deposit_topup_8cd35ccc` for the guest and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `reservation_id` | Reference number of the guest's room reservation the deposit is paid for, as given to the guest by the agent from the reservation lookup | Identifier |
| `amount` | Amount of the further deposit charged to the card, in USD | Positive plain number with 2 decimal places, such as 123.45; stored exactly as given, rounded to 2 decimal places |

**Return.** A text receipt of a dictionary with the keys `charge_id` (reference of the new deposit collection), `reservation_id` (the reservation it is held for), `amount` (the amount collected, USD with 2 decimal places), `posted_date` (the date of the payment, YYYY-MM-DD) and `status`, the literal "collected", which shows the payment went through.

## Points of judgement

- **Money held exceeds what the reservation now requires.** Nothing is refunded under this rule; money already held is never refunded by it.
- **Reservation guaranteed by a card.** The rule concerns resort reservations guaranteed by an advance deposit only.
- **Who pays.** The guest, with the card on file, by running the tool themselves.
